name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Reach
aliases: Kneeling Hip Flexor with Overhead Reach
instructions: Kneel in a half-kneeling lunge with the back knee down and the front foot flat.
Squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg and gently shift the hips forward until you feel a stretch in the front of that hip.
Reach one arm overhead and slightly toward the back-knee side to open the hip and upper back.
Keep the ribs down and the lower back from dumping into a hard arch.
Hold for the set time, then switch sides.
